author: CNN
description:
Some leading Ohio Republicans began distancing themselves from a controversial new ad from their gubernatorial nominee, Vivek Ramaswamy, even as Vice President JD Vance warned the party not to break ranks over the commercial.

The Ramaswamy ad has drawn bipartisan criticism for featuring the estranged mother of his Democratic opponent, Amy Acton. In the video, Acton’s mother called her daughter a liar and urged voters not to support her. Acton has said she has not seen her mother since she was about 12 years old, when the man her mother married sexually abused her and faced criminal charges.

author: CNN
description:
Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil joins CNN's Wolf Blitzer in The Situation Room to talk about his appeal to the Supreme Court.
Khalil also responds to a new Department of Homeland Security statement about the allegations against him.

Khalil, a legal permanent resident who is married to a U.S. citizen, was arrested in March 2025 by Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents in his Columbia campus apartment. He quickly became the face of the Trump administration crackdown on pro-Palestinian demonstrators.

He then spent 104 days in a Louisiana immigration jail, missing the birth of his first child, before a federal judge in New Jersey ordered his release.

Ukraine is urgently trying to develop interceptors capable of countering a new generation of Russian jet-powered drones that have wreaked havoc across the country in recent months. 

Along with the Kremlin’s ballistic weapons and a new type of cruise missile, the jet-drones have caused massive damage in and around the capital, Kyiv. 

CNN had rare access to a jet-powered Russian Geran 4 drone, downed over Ukraine. Nick Paton Walsh was shown Western made components inside. Also, Director of Chatham House's Russia and Eurasia Programme, Gregoire Roos, weighs in on President Trump's recent shift towards Vladimir Putin.

author: CNN
description:
A chemical tank is leaking in Toledo, Ohio, forcing hundreds of residents to evacuate their homes or shelter in place due to fears of a toxic release, and the mayor warned Wednesday that it may still be explosive. 

A sheriff’s deputy was injured when he responded to the leak around 9:30 p.m. Tuesday, Mayor Wade Kapszukiewicz said at a news conference Wednesday morning. Kapszukiewicz provided no information about the deputy’s condition. 

MC Tank Transport said the tank contained glycidyl methacrylate, which it described as “an industrial chemical used to make certain plastics, paints and coatings perform better.” 

CNN's Wolf Blitzer speaks with Toledo Mayor Wade Kapszukiewicz (D) about the emergency response and two Toledo residents who experienced a strange smell and recorded video of smoky conditions near their homes.

title: Evacuations, explosion risk in OH as industrial chemical tank leaks

author: CNN
description:
The campaign of Ohio Republican governor nominee Vivek Ramaswamy said it would launch a $4 million ad campaign featuring a controversial video of his Democratic opponent’s estranged mom after it went viral online. 

The video – which was shared widely on social media, including by the president’s eldest son, Donald Trump Jr. – has roiled the gubernatorial race by bringing the issue of Democratic nominee Amy Acton’s past abuse to the forefront. Acton has said she has not seen her mother since she was about 12 years old, when a man her mother married abused her and faced criminal charges. 

CNN’s Patrick Svitek reports on the controversy, while Democratic strategist Paul Begala and Republican strategist Terry Sullivan condemn the ad as “a moral malignancy” and “stupid,” respectively. Also, CNN's Abby Phillip discusses the controversy with her NewsNight panel of political pundits.

title: 'Scummiest thing I've seen in politics': Ohio ad sparks outrage

description:
One of the nation's top election forecasters is moving 28 House races across 20 states toward Democrats, while the Cook Political Report has shifted two Deep South Senate races to the left. Republican nominees across the country continue to distance themselves from President Trump.
Meanwhile, anxiety over election forecasts has turned a White House that once prided itself on single-minded cohesion into the nerve center of a resurgence in Trump-world infighting and leaks. Several administration officials, advisers and close allies described a toxic mix of jockeying for power and preemptive finger-pointing in the critical final days before November.
